# Tour Montparnasse - Observatoire Panoramique de Paris

> > Paris Montparnasse Observatory offers 360° panoramic views from the 56th floor and rooftop terrace of Tour Montparnasse, featuring VR experiences, AR technology, and spectacular views of the Eiffel Tower and Paris landmarks.

The official website for Tour Montparnasse's observation deck (Observatoire Paris Montparnasse), operated by OPTM. The site provides visitor information, tickets, immersive experiences including Paris Time Travel VR and Magnicity AR app, and guides to the Montparnasse neighborhood. Note: The observatory will close March 31, 2026 for renovation.

## Key Topics

- Tour Montparnasse observation deck
- Panoramic views of Paris
- Eiffel Tower viewpoint
- 56th floor rooftop terrace
- Paris Time Travel VR experience
- Magnicity augmented reality app
- Panoramart art exhibition
- Montparnasse neighborhood
- Paris monuments (Arc de Triomphe, Louvre, La Défense, Seine)
- Tourist attraction and visitor information
- 360° observation deck
- Paris travel tips and guides
- Observatory closure 2026
- OPTM operations

## Visitor Information & Tickets

- [Montparnasse Tower Panoramic Observation Deck](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com): Homepage for Montparnasse Tower with tickets, VR, and rooftop access
- [Tour Montparnasse : découvrez l'une des plus belles vues sur Paris](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/fr/tour-montparnasse-une-vue-exceptionnelle-sur-lensemble-de-paris): Historic Tour Montparnasse overview with panoramic Paris views
- [Contact](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/contact): Contact info, FAQ, and visitor policies for Paris Montparnasse Observatory
- [Paris Montparnasse Observatory to Close on March 31, 2026](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/paris-montparnasse-observatory-to-close-on-march-31-2026): Closure announcement for March 2026 renovation by Magnicity

## Immersive Experiences

- [Paris Time Travel](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/paris-time-travel): VR experience exploring Paris history from Lutetia to Notre-Dame
- [Application Magnicity](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/fr/application-magnicity): Magnicity AR app with 360° augmented reality views of Paris landmarks
- [Panoramart](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/fr/panoramart-decouvrez-10-peintures-murales-a-couper-le-souffle-a-paris-montparnasse): Panoramart art exhibition with murals by Aurélien Jeanney at observatory

## Views & Landmarks

- [LA MEILLEURE VUE DE LA TOUR EIFFEL](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/fr/la-meilleure-vue-de-la-tour-eiffel): Best Eiffel Tower viewpoint from Tour Montparnasse rooftop terrace
- [THE PRETTIEST VIEW OF PARIS](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/the-prettiest-view-of-paris): Panoramic views of Paris monuments from Montparnasse Tower observation deck
- [SPECTACULAR VIEW OF ARC DE TRIOMPHE](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/spectacular-view-of-arc-de-triomphe): Arc de Triomphe views from 56th floor terrace at Montparnasse Tower

## Paris Travel Guides

- [Blog](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/blog): Blog hub for Paris Montparnasse Observatory and neighborhood guides
- [What to do in Paris when it rains? 10 ideas!](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/what-to-do-in-paris-when-it-rains): Rainy day guide featuring Tour Montparnasse, museums, and Paris cafes
- [Le quartier Montparnasse](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/fr/quartier-montparnasse): Montparnasse neighborhood guide with museums, restaurants, and attractions
- [Paris la nuit : Les 7 meilleures choses à faire](https://www.tourmontparnasse56.com/fr/paris-la-nuit-7-choses-a-faire): Night activities guide featuring Tour Montparnasse and Seine cruises
